newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sylvan Learning cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sylvan Learning cut.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it downgraded Sylvan Learning Systems Inc to outperform from buy.
-- cited shortfall in Sylvan's testing business. Testing revenues were up 33 percent in the fourth quarter, falling below Lehman's estimate of nearly 45 percent growth.
-- said fourth quarter operating margins also fell below expectations.
-- said Sylvan has attractive longer-term growth prospects.
-- Sylvan lost 3/4 to 34-3/4 in morning trading.
